transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: reasoningEffort is read on session.start, session.resume, and session.model_change. auto_mode_resolved does not update effort.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: A non-empty string emits effort:updated intent observed. A missing value emits nothing and does not retract.
